регионы.фраза: Harvesting of main season cereals continues along the Sahel and overall cropping prospects remain mostly favourable in non-conflict affected areas and despite localized dryness.
Planting for the 2026/27 main season is underway and below-normal rainfall is expected through the start of the season from October 2026 to January 2027 (See Regional Outlook Pg.
In the south, harvesting of dry-season rice is underway and yield conditions are mixed due to below-average rainfall during the growing season.
